actions.description:
Frequency three times per day

Effect The shadow drake Strides or Flies twice.
actions.name: Speed Surge

actions.description:
Trigger A creature attacks the shadow drake while it is in an area of dim light

Effect The shadow drake further obscures its position. The attacker must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] check in order to affect the shadow drake, as if the drake were Hidden for the triggering attack.
actions.name: Shadow Evade
actions.trigger: A creature attacks the shadow drake while it is in an area of dim light

actions.description: The shadow drake makes one bite Strike and two tail Strikes in any order.
actions.name: Draconic Frenzy

actions.description:
A shadow drake spits a ball of black liquid that explodes into a cloud of frigid black shadow. This attack has a range of 40 feet and explodes in a 5-foot-radius burst. Creatures within the burst take @Damage[3d6[cold]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save). The explosion of shadow also snuffs out mundane light sources the size of a torch, lantern, or smaller, and attempts to counteract magical light with a +10 counteract modifier.

The shadow drake can't use Shadow Breath again for [[/r 1d6]] rounds.
actions.name: Shadow Breath

actions.description: The shadow drake's form shifts and blends reflexively with surrounding shadows. A shadow drake gains an additional reaction each round, but it can use this reaction only for Shadow Evade.
actions.name: Shadow Blend

name: Shadow Drake
publicNotes: Shadow drakes are typically among the smallest and least powerful of their species. Most stand as tall and long as house cats and have charcoal-colored scales and membranous wings just translucent enough to pass for shadows. Attracted to shiny materials, they employ deception, teamwork, and even rudimentary traps to create opportunities to make off with ill-gotten gains. Shadow drakes have a particular fascination and admiration for umbral dragons-a notable exception to the norm for drakes and dragons.
